Cost: x1 Base Weapon Cost [Minimum 1,000eb] ♦ Availability: +1 Price Category of Base Weapon [Minimum V. Expensive]

Mods: All Non-Explosive Weapons which deal damage

Biggerin’ my caliber, biggerin’ my blade, biggerin’ the blood spray!

The weapon deals 1d6 additional damage, and its Autofire Rating (if any) is increased by 1. This also applies to non-Autofire special firing modes, such as Shotgun Shells. The weapon is no longer Concealable, and it cannot be silenced or suppressed in any way. This mod and the weapon cannot be Tech Upgraded to remove any of these penalties.

If the weapon already has a BODY requirement of any kind (wielding, jams, not suffering a Critical Injury when fired, etc), it is increased by half (Round Up) the number of damage die it now rolls for non-Aimed Single Shot Attacks which add to the attack’s total damage and are not dropped (e.g., an Upsized Power 6d6 [5d6+1d6] weapon that had a BODY 11 Minimum now has a BODY 14 Minimum [11+3]).

If the weapon does not have a BODY stat minimum to be wielded, it gains one equal to the Upsized Recoil Table. Being mounted also satisfies the new BODY Minimum. For One Handed weapons, the user may choose to make it Two Handed when this mod is installed.

For weapons that can only use an Alternate Firing Mode (e.g., Autofire), the new/modified BODY minimum is based on their base weapon type’s rolled damage (for Machine Guns, use Assault Rifles), but does not actually enable Single Shot attacks with the weapon.

◈ UPSIZED RECOIL
WEAPON TYPE BODY MINIMUM
All Weapon Types (# of die rolled that add to the total damage on a Non-Aimed Single Shot Attack Post-Mod) * 2
MODIFIERS BONUS TO BODY MIN.
One-Handed, or a Bow +2 BODY Min.
ROF 2 or higher +1 BODY Min.
Only fires in Autofire or has Autofire (5)+ Pre-mod +2 BODY Min.

EX: A Heavy Pistol (ROF 2, 3d6, One-Handed) has its Single Shot damage increased to 4d6, and gains a BODY 11 Minimum to wield ([4 Damage Die * 2] + 2 [One-Handed] +1 [ROF 2] = 11). If they choose to make the pistol Two-Handed, it instead gains a BODY 9 Minimum.

Attachment slots: 0 (Weapon Mod)

Foundry notes:

  • Costs the base weapon's cost (minimum 1,000eb); the listed price is the minimum.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Mod Catalog > Weapon Mods).
